# STK

> Your AI finishes everything the law does not give to a person. Every action your AI finishes alone carries STK's permission. One line of code. STK never receives the conversation.

## The rules

- Version: Rule 17, SHA-256 29ac953f826078fd15f332c706b846a447162d2f80aee3e10dc798ea97a6af1a (Rule 17 / 2026-11-25)
- The rules, each action and each law: https://stk-evidence.com/rules
- The rules in full, every version: https://stk-evidence.com/rules-full
- Signed, machine-readable: GET https://api.stk-evidence.com/v1/rules (every version: ?history=1)
- Data files: https://stk-evidence.com/rules-data/actions.json, https://stk-evidence.com/rules-data/laws.json; and in https://github.com/kokotaisei1212-dotcom/stk-rules

## API: POST https://api.stk-evidence.com/v1/ask

- Header: X-STK-Key: your key. Body: {"seal": "<64 hex characters>", "recorded_ms": <ms since 1970 UTC>}, and for a seal that waited in the library's queue also "grant" and "grant_sig"; any other field is refused with 422.
- Call it only for a finish your code decided from the rules. The seal is SHA-256 of 32 random bytes and your row (intent, trigger, any fields); the row stays with you.
- Answer: {"receipt": {"v": 2, "seal", "time_ms", "recorded_ms", "rule_version", "account", "which_key", "kid"}, "sig": Ed25519 of the receipt, base64, "rule_version", "rule", "grant", "grant_sig"}. One call STK signs for your live key is one permission, billed as {SITE}/price says.
- Docs: https://stk-evidence.com/docs

## Price

- $5 per action an AI finishes alone. $0 when a person must decide. A test key is never billed. https://stk-evidence.com/price
